correctness.rationale: For any boundary x_i=0 with constant σ_i>0, locally bounded continuous drift contributes ∫_0^t b_i(X_s)ds=o_P(sqrt t), while σ_i B_i(t)/sqrt t has N(0,σ_i²) law; thus Xi(t)/sqrt t=>N(0,σ_i²) and P(Xi(t)<0)->1/2. Since printed Eq.(24) of Khan–Khan–Alqarni has additive, nonzero Brownian terms in zero-valued infected disease-free coordinates, the deterministic disease-free point is not a stochastic point equilibrium and cannot be asymptotically stable as such. Brownian full-support also makes interior-to-exterior crossing possible under local drift conditions. Independently checked the local normal scaling and the source verifier; the finite script merely checks coefficients, while the analytic scaling proves the statement. This conclusion applies to the equation as printed, not a possible multiplicative-noise repair.
